name: Modular HW Monitor
author: Tymur Bogach
description: Any metric on any machine: CPU, GPU, memory and every fan, one compact read-out each in the bar. Click one for the menu, where every row names what it toggles; right-click cycles Digits, Gauges and Combo modes. Reads /proc and /sys/class/hwmon directly — no lm_sensors, no vendor lock-in.
